headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 30, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 6-1 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Carmen Mlodzinski earning the win. Nick Gonzales led the Pirates' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance. The Cincinnati Reds dominated the Milwaukee Brewers, winning 7-2 behind Chase Burns' win and Jose Trevino's 3-hit, 1-home run performance. The Colorado Rockies routed the Miami Marlins 14-4, led by Jake McCarthy's 2-hit, 1-home run, 4-RBI performance.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries. Julio Rodríguez has been placed on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion, while Cooper Criswell has been transferred to the 60-day injured list with a right shoulder strain. Ryan Helsley, Bennett Sousa, Carlos Rodón, Jason Adam, and Mitchell Parker have also been placed on the injured list with various injuries.

The Washington Nationals made a pair of trades, acquiring Tom Cosgrove from the Houston Astros and Kyle Nicolas from the Baltimore Orioles. The Athletics traded Ben Hansen to the Boston Red Sox for Brett Harris, while the Texas Rangers traded Ben Hartl to the Chicago White Sox for Ben Peoples.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Phillies 6-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 6-1 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Carmen Mlodzinski earning the win. Nick Gonzales led the Pirates' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Brewers 7-2**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 7-2 victory over the Milwaukee Brewers, with Chase Burns earning the win. Jose Trevino led the Reds' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance, driving in 3 runs.

top_news.title: **Rockies Rout Marlins 14-4**
top_news.summary: The Colorado Rockies dominated the Miami Marlins, securing a 10-run victory. Jake McCarthy led the Rockies' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 4-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Guardians Edge White Sox in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 6-5 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Tim Herrin earning the win. Brayan Rocchio led the Guardians' offense with a home run and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Rout Cubs 17-1 in Dominant Performance**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured a convincing 17-1 victory over the Chicago Cubs, with multiple players contributing to the team's high-scoring effort. Iván Herrera, Alec Burleson, Masyn Winn, Bryan Torres, José Fermín, Blaze Jordan, Nathan Church, and Alex Bregman all had notable performances in the win.

top_news.title: **Julio Rodríguez Placed on 7-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Seattle Mariners center fielder Julio Rodríguez has been placed on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion.

top_news.title: **Nationals Acquire Left-Handed Pitcher Tom Cosgrove**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of Tom Cosgrove, acquired from the Houston Astros in a trade for cash. Cosgrove joins the Nationals' roster, bringing his pitching experience to the team.
